entities.name: David H. Gambrell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Henry Gambrell was an American attorney and politician from the U.S. state of Georgia who served as the chairman of the Georgia Democratic Party in the early 1970s and served in the United States Senate from 1971 to 1972.
